purpose: Document independent city-specific registry source review and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Bounded OGC API query returned three full GeoJSON MultiPolygons. Point-in-ring test found no point-containing feature. Nearest polygon `26211032670000` (kadastrale parcel id) is approximately 3.56 m from the WUP point; only parcel identifier components and unchanged geometry are retained.\nExact request: https://api.pdok.nl/kadaster/brk-kadastrale-kaart/ogc/v1/collections/perceel/items?f=json&limit=3&crs=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.opengis.net%2Fdef%2Fcrs%2FOGC%2F1.3%2FCRS84&bbox=5.08091362175478%2C52.0839427734495%2C5.08111362175478%2C52.0841427734495&bbox-crs=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.opengis.net%2Fdef%2Fcrs%2FOGC%2F1.3%2FCRS84&filter=%28status_historie_code%20%3D%20%27G%27%29&filter-lang=cql2-text\nResult: HTTP 200; 3 GeoJSON polygons; none contains locator; nearest sample about 3.56 m away.
registryAssessment: The national Kadaster holds the cadastral parcel dataset used in Utrecht, and the municipality publishes its geodata portal. The official open PDOK OGC API returned three polygons in a 0.0002° point-centered envelope; none contains the unchanged WUP point. The nearest returned polygon is about 3.56 m away and is retained as nearby evidence only.
